h1:
10 Nature Stays for
Fresh Mountain Air in Nan
That We've Already Reviewed
heroSub: 10 hand-picked nature stays in Nan that we've already reviewed in depth, most of them in Pua district on the road up to Doi Phu Kha — wake up to a sea of mist over the rice terraces and a mountain view filling your window. From a cocoa-themed resort to rice-view boutiques to homestays in the fields for a few hundred baht, starting around ฿360–1,450/night.
introH2: 🌿 What kinds of nature stays does Nan have, and how do you pick the right one?
introHtml: When people picture the nature side of Nan, they usually see green rice terraces, mountains as a backdrop, and a thin sea of mist drifting over the treetops in the morning — and the place where all of that comes together most is Pua district, on the road up to Doi Phu Kha, which is where almost every stay in this article sits. But "nature stay in Nan" doesn't come in just one shape. Some are boutique resorts on a hill where you pull back the curtains to a full rice-field view, some are wooden homestays in the middle of the fields that cost a few hundred baht and put you right up close to nature, and some have a theme all their own, like a cocoa resort where you wake up to the smell of chocolate. Plenty of first-time visitors to Nan book on the wrong side and end up with a room looking out at a car park instead of the rice fields, feeling like they missed the thing they came for. This article rounds up 10 nature stays in Nan that we've already reviewed in depth — every one drawn from reading real guest reviews, with the genuine upsides and the honest caveats, prices compared across 3 sites, and direct booking links throughout, so you can pick the one that matches the Nan you actually had in mind.
mrtHtml: Nan has no rail transit and limited public transport, so for nature trips you'll really want your own car or a rental for almost everything. If you fly into Nan Nakhon Airport, the easiest move is to rent a car in town from the start. Almost all the stays in this article are in Pua district, about a 1.5-hour drive from Nan town, so budget time for that leg. Pua makes a good base for driving on to Doi Phu Kha National Park (about 40 min from the town centre), the Ban Sapan viewpoints, and the ancient Bo Kluea rock-salt wells (about an hour). Popular spots in Pua itself include Wat Phuket with its rice-terrace view, the Tai Lue village cafés, and Wat Phra That Beng Sakat. The roads here wind up into the mountains, so fill the tank and set off early.

entries.type: Cocoa-Themed Boutique Resort · in Pua town
entries.name: Cocoa Valley Resort
entries.revCount: Trip.com 9.2 · 12 reviews · one of the top specialty stays in Pua
entries.badge: 🍫 The only cocoa-themed stay in Nan
entries.mrtTag: 📍 In Pua town · near Wat Phra That Beng Sakat
entries.addr: 339 Moo 8, Pua subdistrict, Pua district, Nan
entries.storyHtml: Among Nan's nature stays, Cocoa Valley Resort sells something no one else does, because it's the only cocoa-themed boutique resort in the province, sitting right in the middle of Pua town. What people talk about most starts the moment you open the door, with cookies and a cold cocoa drink waiting for you, faintly cocoa-scented toiletries in the bathroom, and a cup of hot chocolate at check-in. The heart of the place is its in-house chocolate café and a workshop where you make chocolate from cocoa beans by hand, running twice a day at 09:30 and 13:30, with the owner telling the story of the cocoa grown in the area themselves. Plenty of reviews say it's genuinely fun and you actually learn something, which makes it a great fit for families with kids and couples who want an activity to do together. All 12 rooms are decorated in warm tones to match the theme, with comfortable beds, spacious bathrooms, and a private balcony. The in-town location is a plus because it's easy to head out for dinner or one of Pua's well-known cafés without a long drive, and it works as a base for driving on to Doi Phu Kha, Bo Kluea, or Ban Sapan. But to be honest from the real reviews, the draw here isn't the view, because the resort sits in town rather than up on a hill, so the mountain view isn't as clear as in the promo photos, and there's no swimming pool. The thing that comes up most is noise, because it's close to Highway 101 — rooms on the road side hear traffic during the day and the sound insulation isn't great, so if you're a light sleeper, ask for an inner room when you book. Put simply, if you're coming to Pua for a sea of mist over the rice fields filling your window, this may not be the answer, but if you want a cocoa-themed experience you can't get anywhere else in Nan, from around ฿1,450/night you get plenty of fun and character for the money.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you're a light sleeper, ask for an inner room that doesn't face the road when you book, and plan to catch the chocolate workshop at one of its 09:30 or 13:30 slots — set aside the separate activity fee, because it's the highlight you shouldn't miss.
pros: Cocoa theme done seriously, from the in-room welcome to the chocolate café
The make-your-own chocolate workshop is fun, great for families and couples
Nicely decorated rooms, comfortable beds, easy to reach in town
cons: Not a view stay, since it's in town rather than up on a hill
No swimming pool, unlike the hillside resorts in Pua
Close to Highway 101 — road-side rooms hear daytime traffic (from reviews)

entries.name: PuaDeView Boutique Resort
entries.badge: 🏞️ Pay in the hundreds, a million-baht view
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Ban Kaem · Pua district · 2-min walk to Wat Phra That Beng Sakat
tags: 🛕 Near Wat Phra That Beng Sakat
entries.addr: 222 Moo 5, Ban Kaem, Woranakhon subdistrict, Pua district, Nan
entries.storyHtml: If your mental image of Nan is green rice terraces with mountains as a backdrop, waking up to thin mist drifting over the treetops, PuaDeView Boutique Resort is the stay in this article that delivers that picture most directly. It's a two-storey, 17-room boutique resort on a hill in Pua district, near Wat Phra That Beng Sakat, that Nan travellers describe with the catchphrase "pay in the hundreds, a million-baht view" — and that isn't the resort's own marketing, it's a line that keeps surfacing in real reviews until it became the way people remember the place. The key thing to understand before booking is that the rooms split clearly into two sides: the side facing the rice/mountain view, and the side with no view. Reviews warn in unison that some non-view rooms look out at a car park instead of the fields, so if you're coming for the view, specify when booking that you want a view-side room — the price difference is small but the feeling is a whole different story. The highlight every review mentions is the outdoor pool facing the mountains, not large and meant for soaking while taking in the view, and some ground-floor rooms are pool-access, where you step straight out the door into the pool — those are the ones people love and that fill up first. Service gets consistent praise, with the owner and staff described as friendly and attentive. But honestly, this is a small boutique stay with clear weak points: the walls between rooms are thin enough to hear next door, the beds are fairly firm for some people, breakfast has a limited menu that repeats over several nights, and the building has no lift, so a second-floor room means hauling your bags up the stairs. If the heart of your trip is pulling back the curtains to a rice-and-mountain view and taking photos by the pool, the few thousand baht you spend gets you a view beyond its price, as a great many reviews confirm in unison.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Specify a rice/mountain-view room when you book, because not every room sees the view. Pack earplugs since the walls are thin, and head out to sit by the pool early in the morning to watch the mist over the fields — the most beautiful stretch of the day.
pros: Lovely rice-terrace and mountain views, especially in the morning mist
Mountain-view pool, and pool-access rooms that step straight into the pool
Friendly owner and staff, good value for the view you get
cons: Thin walls between rooms, you hear the neighbours (from reviews)
Fairly firm beds, limited breakfast menu that repeats
No lift, and the non-view rooms look out at the car park

entries.type: Bungalow Resort · rice/mountain views · Pua district
entries.name: Ozone Park Nan
entries.revCount: Trip.com · rice-view bungalows, Ban Nat, Chai Watthana subdistrict
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Ban Nat · Chai Watthana subdistrict · Pua district
entries.addr: 188 Moo 4, Liap Khlong Chonprathan Rd, Ban Nat, Chai Watthana subdistrict, Pua district, Nan
entries.storyHtml: The name Ozone Park Nan spells out exactly what the place sets out to give you: getting out to breathe clean air in the middle of Pua district's nature. This is a bungalow resort in Ban Nat, Chai Watthana subdistrict, with mountains wrapping around it and greenery throughout, plus a naturally styled pool in the centre that makes it feel cool and pleasant on arrival. Most of the buildings are timber, so it feels close to nature, but inside you still get the basic comforts — air-con, fridge, flat-screen TV, en-suite bathroom, and Wi-Fi around the grounds. What suits the nature crowd is that there are bikes to ride around the area, the balconies are an easy place to watch the sunset in the evening, and in the morning you feel the mist drift in close, cool and fresh. The location is out toward Ban Nat from Pua town, about 50 minutes to an hour from Nan Airport, and it makes a good starting point for driving up Doi Phu Kha. Prices start around ฿750/night for a twin room, around ฿850 for a rice/mountain-view room, and around ฿1,200 for a family room. To be honest, this is a small local stay that doesn't yet have an overall score on the major booking platforms, so it's worth checking service and room details with the property directly before booking, especially the family room, where you should confirm the number of guests it takes. It suits people after a budget bungalow in nature, with bikes to ride and a simple view to sit and take in, not expecting big-resort service.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Since this is a small local stay without an overall platform score yet, contact the property directly about availability and the family-room details before booking, and confirm your room is on the rice/mountain-view side if that's what you want.

Bikes to ride, sunsets to watch and morning mist

entries.name: Hinpha Homestay
entries.revCount: Agoda 9.4 · Booking 9.2 · Ban Don Sathan, Sathan subdistrict
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Ban Don Sathan · Sathan subdistrict · ~10 min drive from Pua town
entries.addr: 134 Moo 12, Ban Don Sathan, Sathan subdistrict, Pua district, Nan
entries.storyHtml: Hinpha Homestay is the nature homestay that scores highest among the homestays in this article, at 9.4 on Agoda and 9.2 on Booking.com. It sits at Ban Don Sathan, Sathan subdistrict, about a 10-minute drive from Pua town, in an area of open fields, trees and little flowers, with Doi Phu Kha as the backdrop, giving it a calm, cool, easygoing feel. What sets it apart from a typical homestay is that it has houses in several styles to choose from by budget and group size, from a budget wooden cabin with a shared bathroom at around ฿700, to entry rooms and houses with air-con at around ฿900, up to wooden houses with balconies looking over the rice fields, a stargazing house with a rooftop deck, and mountain-view houses with big beds — some with a bathtub — at around ฿1,800, which suit couples. The rooms and houses come with the full set of comforts: air-con, TV, fridge, hot water and free Wi-Fi, and every room includes breakfast. There are also bikes to ride around the grounds, some rooms have a balcony to take in the view from your room, and every morning you sip and eat amid the cool damp of nature and the mist drifting around the mountains. One thing many people love especially is that it's pet-friendly, which is rare among regular stays, making it great for anyone who wants to bring the dog or cat along. With consistently high review scores and a wide range of houses covering everything from budget to couples, Hinpha Homestay is a well-rounded choice for anyone who wants to genuinely sleep in nature homestay-style without giving up cleanliness and comfort.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Pick a house type that matches your budget and group size. For couples after something special, look at the mountain-view house with a bathtub, and if you're bringing a pet, let the homestay know in advance to confirm the conditions.
pros: High scores, Agoda 9.4 · Booking 9.2, consistently
Houses in several styles, from a budget cabin to a mountain-view house with a bathtub
Doi Phu Kha view, breakfast included, bikes to ride, and pet-friendly
cons: About a 10-minute drive from Pua town, you'll want your own car
The budget cabin has a shared bathroom, so pick the right type
It's a homestay, no big-resort facilities

entries.name: Chomphu Phukha Resort
entries.badge: 🏔️ Plenty of rooms, on the road up Doi Phu Kha
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Pua town · Nan–Thung Chang Rd · road up to Doi Phu Kha
tags: 🏔️ Road up to Doi Phu Kha
entries.addr: 382 Moo 8, Nan–Thung Chang Rd, Pua subdistrict, Pua district, Nan
entries.storyHtml: Chomphu Phukha Resort is the choice for anyone who wants a resort in Pua town with enough rooms to take a group or a large family, at a reasonable mid-range price. It sits on Nan–Thung Chang Road in Pua subdistrict, right on the route up to Doi Phu Kha, so it's very convenient for anyone using Pua as a base for driving on to nature spots up in the mountains. It's a roughly 66-room resort with both older and newer buildings, set in green, shady surroundings that fit the area's nature, with garden corners and lounging spots in several styles. The rooms range from budget Standard rooms in the older building at around ฿900, to wider, newer Resort and Deluxe rooms at around ฿1,200–1,500, up to Connecting rooms or Suites at around ฿2,100 that suit families or groups who want adjoining rooms. Inside, the rooms have the basic comforts — air-con, TV, fridge, and some with a balcony to take in the view — plus Wi-Fi around the grounds. To be honest from the real reviews, the scores here are mid-range, Booking 7.9 and Agoda 7.8, not as high as some of Pua's boutiques or rice-view homestays, because being a large resort with a mix of old and new buildings means the room quality isn't consistent and the older-building rooms clearly look more dated. If you book here, it's worth asking whether you'll get a room in the new or old building so it matches your expectations. It suits people who care more about the location on the road up Doi Phu Kha and having enough rooms for a group than about the view or boutique design.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: There are both older and newer buildings here and the room quality differs, so ask and specify a new-building or Deluxe room when you book to get a room that matches what you expect.
pros: Plenty of rooms, around 66, can take groups and large families
In Pua town on the road up Doi Phu Kha, easy to head out from
Green, shady surroundings, prices start in the mid-hundreds
cons: Mid-range scores, Booking 7.9 · Agoda 7.8 (from reviews)
Mix of old and new buildings, inconsistent room quality
Not focused on rice views or boutique design like the top-ranked stays

entries.type: Homestay in the Rice Fields + Camping Ground · Pua district
entries.name: Ton Lang Homestay
entries.revCount: Booking 8.6 · Agoda 8.6 · next to Wat Ton Laeng (Tai Lue)
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Ban Ton Laeng · Chai Watthana subdistrict · next to Wat Ton Laeng
tags: 🛕 Next to Tai Lue Wat Ton Laeng
entries.addr: 76/2 Moo 2, Ban Ton Laeng, Chai Watthana subdistrict, Pua district, Nan
entries.storyHtml: If you're after the cheapest nature stay in Nan, Ton Lang Homestay is the answer, starting at just around ฿360/night, the cheapest in this article. Ton Laeng Homestay sits at Ban Ton Laeng, Chai Watthana subdistrict, Pua district, next to Wat Ton Laeng, an old Tai Lue temple of the area, so you get the nature setting and a touch of local culture together. Its standout feature is being a homestay in the rice fields with a bamboo bridge across the paddies, a popular photo spot especially when the rice is green and the morning mist is out, with green fields and a ring of mountains around it, places to sit and relax, and a balcony to take in the view or watch the sunset for a nice atmosphere. The accommodation comes in several types, from a standard room for 2 at around ฿360 with air-con, TV, a small fridge and an en-suite bathroom with hot water, to a triple room at around ฿520, up to a big family house that takes around 6 people at around ฿690, which is great value for a group. What the camping crowd loves is the camping ground by the rice fields for anyone who wants to sleep right up close to nature — check the fee and gear with the homestay first. With a matching 8.6 on both Booking and Agoda, Ton Lang Homestay is genuinely good value for budget travellers and groups of friends who want to sleep in the rice fields at a price that's hard to find. Honestly, the facilities are simple homestay-style rather than luxurious, but what you get is a real, tangible rice-field setting and Tai Lue culture.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you're a group, take the family room that fits around 6 people — much better value. And if the camping ground interests you, contact the homestay ahead about the fee and gear, and go walk the bamboo bridge during the misty early morning.

Homestay in the rice fields, with a bamboo-bridge photo spot and a camping ground

entries.name: Pua Good View Homestay
entries.revCount: Agoda 8.9 · Booking 8.8 · Sathan subdistrict, near the Pua River
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Sathan subdistrict · Pua district · near the Pua River
entries.addr: Sathan subdistrict, Pua district, Nan (north of the town, near the Pua River)
entries.storyHtml: Pua Good View Homestay is a nature homestay that, as the name says, sells the view, and it lives up to it with 8.9 on Agoda and 8.8 on Booking.com. It sits in Sathan subdistrict, north of Pua town, near the Pua River, in green open-field surroundings with mountains as a backdrop. What sets it apart from a typical homestay is that the building is modern, finished in bare concrete that looks stylish and unusual compared with the homestays you usually see, yet it still sits amid the feel of nature and open fields, blending modern with rural nicely. The rooms come with the full set of comforts — air-con, TV, fridge, hot water and Wi-Fi — and every room includes breakfast. There are rooms by group size, from a double for 2 at around ฿1,200, to a triple at around ฿1,700, up to a family room for 4 at around ฿2,000 that suits groups or families. The highlight here is the morning, eating breakfast while watching the mist drift across the fields and the mountains — the picture of Pua that many people come looking for. With consistently high review scores and a design more modern than the usual homestay, Pua Good View suits anyone who wants to sleep amid a rice-field view homestay-style but still wants a room that looks good and has some style. Honestly, the starting price is a fair bit higher than the budget homestays in this article, but it trades that for design and a view that earn praise in the reviews, and since it's outside the town, you'll want your own car to head out.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Getting up early for breakfast while watching the mist over the rice fields is the best stretch of atmosphere. If you're a group, the family room is better value, and have your own car ready for heading on to Doi Phu Kha.

Modern bare-concrete design, looks better than the usual homestay

entries.type: Budget Apartment · Woranakhon subdistrict, Pua district
entries.name: Nakorn Nan Apartment
entries.badge: 🛏️ Clean rooms, easy on the wallet, near town
entries.storyHtml: Nakorn Nan Apartment is a budget choice in Pua town for anyone who wants a clean, simple room to sleep in and to save their budget for exploring the nature around Pua instead. It sits in Woranakhon subdistrict, Pua district, a modern-looking 20-room concrete building that's more apartment than resort, so the focus is on cleanliness and the basics. The rooms are simply decorated, easy on the eye and clean, with air-con, a fridge, and a private balcony to sit and catch the breeze, a bathroom with a shower, and Wi-Fi on offer. The surroundings feel open and airy, with a mountain view that sometimes has thin mist drifting through, to sit and take in from your room balcony. The property has bikes to ride out for activities or to take in the surroundings, which is a nice way to explore Pua slowly. The rooms run from a Standard Twin with two single beds at around ฿549, a Standard Double with a big bed at around ฿650, up to around ฿913 in high season or on long weekends. With a matching 8.0 on both Booking and Agoda, it sits in the budget tier that does its job well — clean and good value. To be honest, the draw here isn't a grand view or resort atmosphere, but value and a location in town with food easy to find, making it a good fit for budget travellers who want to use the stay as just a sleeping base and head out into nature for the main event.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: This works as a budget sleeping base for heading out into nature. If you want a view, ask for a room whose balcony faces the mountain side, and borrow a bike to explore Pua in the cool of the evening.
pros: Prices start at just ฿549, clean, simple rooms, good value
In Pua town, food easy to find, bikes to ride
Every room has a private balcony, some corners see the mountains and mist
cons: It's an apartment, not a resort, no full-on nature setting

entries.type: Small 5-Room Mountain-View Resort + Café/Bar · Pua district
entries.name: Phuka Mountain View Resort & Andresbar
entries.badge: ⛰️ Small mountain-view resort with a bar
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Sathan subdistrict · Pua district · road up to Doi Phu Kha
entries.addr: 120 Moo 9, Sathan subdistrict, Pua district, Nan
entries.storyHtml: Phuka Mountain View Resort & Andresbar is a small resort designed to be private, with just 5 rooms, in Sathan subdistrict, Pua district, on the route up to Doi Phu Kha. The draw is right there in the name: a full mountain view. The resort has a modern, unusual shape that opens up the views all around, with surroundings landscaped green and shady to suit the nature already there, garden corners and lush trees, plus the feel of nature and thin mist drifting through. The grounds step down in levels, with lounging corners in several styles — comfy seating and stylish photo spots alike. What sets it apart from a typical small resort is the in-house Andresbar café and bar, so you can sit with a drink and the mountain view in the evening without going anywhere. The rooms have a private balcony open to the mountain view, ideal for morning coffee with a view, and inside they have the full comforts — air-con, fridge, and Wi-Fi. The rooms range from a Standard with a view balcony at around ฿1,200, a Mountain View Room at around ฿1,500, up to a larger Deluxe at around ฿1,800. To be honest from the reviews, the scores here are mid-range at 8.0 on both Booking and Agoda, and with only 5 rooms it fills up fast, especially in the cool season, so book ahead. It suits couples or small groups who want a private mountain-view resort with a bar on site to relax at, more than a many-room place for a large group.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: There are only 5 rooms here and it fills up fast in the cool season, so book ahead. Pick the Mountain View Room or Deluxe for a full view, and use the Andresbar to sit with a drink and the view in the evening.

In-house Andresbar café and bar, sit and relax with the view
Every room has a mountain-view balcony, ideal for morning coffee with a view

entries.type: Whole-House Studio for Nightly Rental · near Pua town
entries.name: No.45 Staycation
entries.badge: 🏡 Rent the whole house, most private
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Pua district · near Pua municipal market
entries.addr: Pua district (near Pua municipal market), Nan
entries.storyHtml: No.45 Staycation closes the article with a choice unlike the others, because it's a whole-house studio rented out by the night, ideal for anyone who wants maximum privacy and the feel of staying at a friend's place. The location is in Pua district near Pua municipal market, so it's easy to head out for food and supplies, while the surroundings are still green fields wrapped in mountains. The house is a studio of around 86 sq.m., simply decorated and feeling open and airy, with the space divided up well, including 2 private bathrooms and a kitchenette, so a group of friends or a small family renting the whole place can stay together comfortably. What the nature crowd loves is the outdoor area for shared activities like a barbecue, with gear the property provides, which makes an evening in Pua more fun when there's a group of you. With consistently high scores of 9.0 on Agoda and 8.9 on Booking.com, it reflects that past guests were impressed by the privacy and cleanliness here. The thing to understand before booking is that it's a whole-house rental per group, not a per-room booking like a hotel, so it suits groups of friends or families travelling together who want to stay together privately — for one or two people the per-head price may feel less worthwhile than coming as a group. Overall it's a well-rounded choice for a small-group Pua trip that wants a whole house to live slowly in, close to nature and close to town at once.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: This is a whole-house rental per group, best value when there's a group of you to split the cost. Use the kitchenette and the barbecue area to cook dinner together, and walk to Pua municipal market for fresh supplies.

noteHtml: 📌 Note: All prices are approximate starting rates for standard rooms and may change by date and season — always check the real price and compare across 3 sites before booking. faqTitle: FAQ — common traveller questions about nature stays in Nan

faq.q: ❓ Which is the best nature stay in Nan?
faq.a: It depends on your trip style · by score among the homestays, Hinpha Homestay is highest at Agoda 9.4 · for a full rice-terrace and mountain view, PuaDeView Boutique Resort is the picture of Pua people come looking for · for an experience unlike anywhere else, Cocoa Valley Resort is the only cocoa-themed resort in Nan · and on a budget wanting to sleep in the rice fields, Ton Lang Homestay starts at just ฿360

faq.q: ❓ How much do nature stays in Nan cost?
faq.a: In this article prices start at around ฿360–1,450 per night · the most budget end is Ton Lang Homestay from ฿360 and Nakorn Nan Apartment from ฿549 · the boutique/resort end sits at ฿900–1,450, such as PuaDeView ฿1,000 and Cocoa Valley ฿1,450 · all prices are approximate starting rates for standard rooms, and in the cool season prices may run higher than usual

faq.q: ❓ Where are most of Nan's nature stays?
faq.a: Almost all of them in this article are in Pua district, on the road up to Doi Phu Kha, the area where you see the most of Nan's rice terraces, mountains and morning mist · Pua is about a 1.5-hour drive from Nan town, and makes a good base for driving on to Doi Phu Kha National Park, Ban Sapan and the ancient Bo Kluea rock-salt wells

faq.q: ❓ Do I need my own car for a nature trip in Nan?
faq.a: You'll want your own car or a rental, because Nan has no rail transit and limited public transport, especially in Pua district and the outlying nature spots · if you fly into Nan Nakhon Airport, the move is to rent a car in town from the start, so you can head out easily and not get stuck on transport between days

faq.q: ❓ Which Nan stays suit a group or family?
faq.a: If you're a group wanting privacy, No.45 Staycation is a whole-house studio rental with a kitchenette and a barbecue area · for family rooms that take several people there's Ton Lang Homestay (up to around 6) and Pua Good View Homestay · if you want a many-room resort for a large group, Chomphu Phukha Resort has around 66 rooms

faq.q: ❓ How far ahead should I book a Nan stay?
faq.a: Most of Pua's nature stays are small (some just 5 rooms), so they fill up fast · in the cool season (November–January), when Pua is a popular destination, book 1–2 months ahead, especially the rice-view stays and small resorts like Phuka Mountain View · other times, 2–3 weeks is enough · compare Agoda / Booking / Trip.com for the best price before every booking
